module: "State View" window (fg_stateView) of the Flowgraph editor. It lists, graph by graph (recursively from mgr.stateGraph), the states ('states/stateNode' nodes whose target graph is not a stategraph) with a play/pause icon depending on whether they are running. Pure display: nothing is modified in the project. Created via _flowgraph_createMgrWindow, so instantiated by flowgraphEditor for each manager.
notes: A state is displayed as "running" only if mgr.runningState == 'running' and mgr.states:isRunning(state.id) returns true.
States and child graphs are sorted by increasing id.

C.desc: Window class (windowName 'fg_stateView', windowDescription 'State View'). The methods are those called by flowgraphEditor via basewindow.

init.desc: Creates the ImGui text filter and registers the window in the editor (size 150x300, hidden by default).

attach.desc: Stores the current flowgraph manager in self.mgr. Called on each manager change.

drawStategraphRecursive.desc: Draws in two columns the graph name (in brackets, preceded by ' - ' per depth level) then its states with the play_circle_filled icon (running) or pause_circle_outline (stopped), then descends into the child graphs.

draw.desc: Draws the "States View" window if it is visible, from self.mgr.stateGraph. Called every frame by drawEditor.

selectNode.desc: Selects a node in the graph editor (fge.SelectNode).
